senses.gloss:
m. (-भुः)
1 A deity, a divinity.
2 A divinity of a particular order.
E.
ऋ the mother of the gods, भू to be, डु affix; also रिभु.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A name of INDRA.
2 INDRA'S heaven or paradise.
3 The thunderbolt of INDRA.
E.
ऋभु a deity, क्षि to waste, to go, ड aff.

m. (-क्षाः)
INDRA.
E.
ऋभुक्ष paradise, &c. इनि aff.
